messages.content: {"problem": "给定一组小写单词：baridu，fopzvuse，idufokld，lagenu，nubvbi，ogohute，sizibuq，wojery，xemigif。\n现在按如下规则定义新的字母表顺序：把字母 p 按给出的先后顺序整体移到字母表最前面，其余字母保持原来的相对顺序不变。随后按该新字母表的字典序对这些单词进行升序排序。\n请写出排序后排在最前面的 3 个单词，用英文逗号+空格分隔。", "canonical_answer": "baridu, fopzvuse, idufokld", "attempts": [{"panel": 0, "sample": 0, "answer": "baridu, fopzvuse, idufokld", "certificate": "The new alphabet order is p, a, b, c, ..., o, q, ..., z. No word begins with p, so compare initial letters using the unchanged relative order: b < f < i < l < n < o < s < w < x. Therefore the first three words are baridu, fopzvuse, and idufokld."}]}
